blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Language model agents are post-trained and deployed through a harness, the prompts, tools, and control logic that present a task to the model and execute its outputs. Harnesses are often revised and judged by how an already trained model performs under them, which assumes that what the model learned under one harness carries over to the next. We ask what a policy learns from its harness and what survives when the harness changes. Under KL-regularized control, we show that the log odds of an optimal policy recover how strongly its harness favors each action over the others, so a trained policy carries the preferences of its harness. Deployed return then equals the ceiling of the harness, the best return it offers, minus the mismatch of the policy, the return lost to its own suboptimal decisions. Training changes only the mismatch, while changing the harness moves both terms. Comparing harnesses with a fixed model therefore mixes what each harness offers with how well that model uses it. In MiniWoB++, post-training makes a model's preferences specific to its training harness. Reversing the order of the observation fields leaves every optimal decision unchanged yet lowers a trained model's success from 85.0% to 19.2%. Conversely, every new harness that a fixed-model comparison rejects but that raises the ceiling outperforms the original agent after further training under it, and ceiling and mismatch measured beforehand predict these gains. For coding-agent harnesses on Terminal-Bench Lite, ceiling minus mismatch estimated with a stronger model as a stand-in for the optimum reproduces the accuracy ranking, while either term alone does not. Code is available at https://github.com/2020-qqtcg/HRP.
blocks.zh: 语言模型代理人经过培训后,通过给模型带来任务并执行其产出的牵引、提示、工具和控制逻辑加以部署。 通常根据一个已经受过训练的模型在它们下的表现来修改和判断这些模型,而这种模型假设在一个方法下学到的东西会延续到下一个方法。 我们询问一项政策从它的利用中汲取了什么教训,当利用改变时,什么是生存的。 在KL规范化的控制下,我们显示,最佳政策的日志概率恢复了它的利用率,它如何有力地支持每一项行动,而不是其他行动,因此训练有素的政策带有它的优势。 所部署的返回等于所利用的上限,它所提供的最佳返回,减去政策的不匹配,失去对自身不利决定的返回。 训练只改变不匹配,而改变牵引力则会移动两个术语. 因此,用固定的模型来比较各种利用,将每种利用所提供的与该模型的使用程度相混合。 在"MiniWoB++"中,后培训会让一个模型的偏好专门针对其训练用具. 改变观测场的顺序使每个最佳决定保持不变,但使训练有素的模型的成功率从85.0%降至19.2%。 反之,固定模型比较所拒绝的、但提高上限的每一个新工具,在经过进一步培训后,都超过了原制剂,而且预先测得的上限和不匹配预测了这些收益。 对于"终端-Bench Lite"上的编码代理机,天花板减不匹配估计与更强模型相匹配,作为最佳的站点复制了精度排名,而单词中的任何一种都不正确. 代码见https://github.com/2020-qqtcg/HRP.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Language model agents are post-trained and deployed through a harness, the prompts, tools, and control logic that present a task to the model and execute its outputs. Interface design and prompt formatting change agent performance ( Yang et al., 2024 ; Sclar et al., 2024 ) . Automated harness design revises prompts, tools, and workflows and scores each candidate by how a fixed model performs under it ( Hu et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2025b ; Fernando et al., 2023 ; Zhang et al., 2026 ) . Such a score assumes that what the model learned under earlier harnesses carries over to each candidate, yet the same interface change can raise one model’s accuracy and lower that of a fine-tuned model ( Mu et al., 2025 ) . At the same time, training can move behavior that a prompt or a harness supplies into the weights ( Snell et al., 2022 ; Ye et al., 2026 ) , and recent methods adapt harnesses and weights together ( Hebbar et al., 2026 ; Chen et al., 2026 ; Kim et al., 2026 ) . These practices raise the question we study:
blocks.zh: 语言模型代理人经过培训后,通过给模型带来任务并执行其产出的牵引装置、提示、工具和控制逻辑加以部署。 界面设计和快速格式化变化剂性能(Yang等人,2024年;Sclar等人,2024年). 自动吊带设计修改了提示、工具和工作流程,并按其下固定模型的运作方式对每个候选人进行评分(Hu等人,2025年;Zhang等人,2025年b;Fernando等人,2023年;Zhang等人,2026年)。 这样的评分假设,之前在模型下学到的东西会传给每个候选人,但同样的界面变化可以提高一个模型的准确性,降低微调模型的准确性(Mu等人,2025年)。 同时,训练可以将一个即时或牵引补给的行为移入重量(Snell等人,2022年;Ye等人,2026年),而最近的方法可以将牵引和牵引结合(Hebbar等人,2026年;Chen等人,2026年;Kim等人,2026年). 这些做法提出了我们研究的问题:

blocks.en: What does a policy learn from its harness, and what survives when the harness changes?
blocks.zh: 一项政策从它的利用中汲取了什么教训,当利用改变时,什么是生存的?

blocks.en: Two experiments make the question concrete. In the first, we take a web agent post-trained under one harness and reverse the order of the fields in its observation, a JSON object with fields such as the task instruction, the page state, and the available actions. The fields keep their contents. We also hold fixed the actions, their execution, the rewards, and the reference policy that regularizes training, so every optimal decision stays the same. The model still changes its most probable action at about half of the states, and its task success falls from 85.0% to 19.2%. Keeping the decisions a model should make does not keep the decisions it makes.
blocks.zh: 两次实验使问题变得具体. 第一,我们用一个网络代理 在一个工具下训练, 并反转观测中字段的顺序, JSON 对象, 字段有任务指示, 页面状态, 以及可用的动作。 田地保存着内容. 我们还确定行动、执行、奖励以及规范培训的参考政策,因此,每个最佳决定都保持不变。 该模式仍然在大约一半的州改变其最可能的行动,任务成功率从85.0%下降到19.2%。 维持决策模式不能维持其作出的决定。

blocks.en: In the second, a new harness adds batched clicks, which execute two clicks in one decision. The new actions raise the best achievable return, yet the trained model’s success drops when we move it to the new harness without changing its weights. A frozen comparison, which evaluates candidate harnesses with the same trained weights, would therefore reject the new harness. We then train the model further for the same budget under each harness, starting from the same trained weights, which we call the source checkpoint. We call further training under the new harness adaptation, and further training under the original harness continuation. The adapted model succeeds more often than both the source checkpoint and the continued one. The harness that first hurt the model gives the best agent. Figure 1 shows the task success at each step, with the new harness as Harness 1.

blocks.en: We explain both results in the control problem that a harness induces over semantic actions, the operations an agent executes together with their arguments. Under KL-regularized control, the optimal policy is a softmax over action scores. Each score adds an action’s long-term value to its log probability under the reference policy, so an optimal policy’s log odds between two actions are proportional to the difference of their scores. A policy trained to optimality under a harness therefore carries the relative action scores that the harness induces, even though it contains none of the harness’s code, tools, or execution machinery. In this sense, a policy is secretly a harness. In our controlled study, real post-training moves a model’s action scores toward the optimum of its training harness, and each harness leaves its own preferences in the model.

blocks.en: Action scores also show why a trained policy can fail after it is moved to a new harness. The scores a policy carries are the ones it expresses through its training interface, which we call its readout through that interface, and the same weights can express different scores through another interface. A policy is thus secretly its training harness, as read through that harness. A new harness can therefore change which actions are optimal, by moving the optimal scores, and separately change which actions the model picks, by moving the readout. Reversing the observation fields leaves the optimal scores in place and moves only the readout.
blocks.zh: 动作分数还表明,为什么一项经过训练的政策在被移到新的工具后可能会失败。 政策携带的分数是它通过其训练接口表达的分数,我们通过该接口将其读出,同样的分数可以通过另一个接口表达不同的分数. 因此,一项政策是秘密的训练手段,通过这种手段来理解。 因此,新的控制器可以改变哪些动作是最佳的,通过移动最佳分数,并通过移动读出,分别改变模型选择的动作。 反转观测字段留下最佳分数,只移动读数.

blocks.en: Scores fix decisions but not how much return a harness offers, since raising every reward by the same constant changes no decision. To convert score changes into return, we therefore add this value back by applying the regularized performance-gap identity ( Geist et al., 2019 ; O’Donoghue, 2022 ) to the harness-induced problem. Deployed return equals the harness’s ceiling C C , the best return any policy can reach under it, minus the policy’s mismatch M M , the return the policy loses by departing from the optimal policy. The mismatch is the KL divergence from the optimal policy, accumulated along the policy’s own trajectories. The ceiling does not depend on the model’s weights, so training under a fixed harness changes only M M , while a harness change can move both terms. A frozen comparison of harnesses therefore mixes what each harness offers with how well the current checkpoint uses it. In the batched-click example, the new harness raises the ceiling slightly but raises the frozen model’s mismatch about ten times as much, so return falls. Adaptation then lowers the mismatch, and once the mismatch falls below a threshold we derive, the adapted model beats the original model under the original harness. Figure 2 illustrates both steps. Our contributions are as follows.

The target shift is the change in the optimal scores, the training residual is the error that training under the original harness left behind, and the readout drift is the change in the scores that the model expresses. Presentation changes that keep every optimal decision isolate the readout drift, and they alone can make a trained model fail on most tasks.

blocks.en: 4 Why Policy Transfer Fails
blocks.zh: 4 为什么政策转移失败

blocks.en: Section 3 shows that a trained policy carries the relative action scores of its training harness. It carries them in its readout through the training interface rather than independently of that interface, so the same weights need not express the same preferences under another harness. A harness change can therefore break a policy that has learned its training harness well.
blocks.zh: 第3节显示,训练有素的政策与其培训手段的相对行动分数相同。 它通过培训接口而不是独立于该接口来读取它们,因此,同样的权重不需要在另一种控制下表达相同的偏好. 因此,利用方式的改变可以打破已经很好地了解其培训方式的政策。

blocks.en: 7 Discussion and Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 讨论和结论

blocks.en: A policy trained under a harness learns the harness’s relative action scores and expresses them through its interface. Post-training makes these preferences harness-specific, and a new interface can change the model’s choices even when every optimal decision stays the same. Because deployed return is the ceiling minus the mismatch, a harness that offers more can hurt a trained model and become the best choice after adaptation. Mismatch estimated from sampled actions predicts these changes when the optimum is known, and for coding agents, teacher-based estimates of ceiling minus mismatch order harnesses by accuracy. Harness evaluations should therefore report the ceiling next to the frozen return, evaluate several checkpoints under each harness rather than a single one, and check how presentation changes move the model’s choices. Harness distillation and joint adaptation of harnesses and weights ( Ye et al., 2026 ; Chen et al., 2026 ; Kim et al., 2026 ) can use sampled-action measurements to track the ceiling and the mismatch separately. Appendix A discusses related work.
blocks.zh: 一项训练有素的政策, 后培训使得这些偏好具有特殊性,新的界面可以改变模型的选择,即使每个最佳决定保持不变。 因为部署的返回是天花板减去不匹配,一个提供更多技术的绳索会伤害一个训练有素的模型,成为适应后的最佳选择. 从抽样动作中估算出的误差预言这些变化是在已知最佳时发生的,对于编码剂,基于教师的天花板减不匹配顺序估计通过准确性加以控制. 因此,应进行合理评价,报告冻结返回的旁边的上限,评价每个控制下的几个检查站,而不是一个检查站,并检查列报方式如何改变模型的选择。 牵引力蒸馏和联合改造牵引力和重量(Ye等人,2026年;Chen等人,2026年;Kim等人,2026年)可以使用抽样动作测量,分别跟踪天花板和错配. 附 录 讨论相关工作。

blocks.en: Regularized control and decision geometry. Control as inference and RL with a maximum entropy objective express optimal policies through rewards, action values, and reference distributions ( Levine, 2018 ; Haarnoja et al., 2017 ; Haarnoja et al., 2018 ) . Regularized control supplies the Gibbs policy and the geometry of the value gap ( Geist et al., 2019 ; O’Donoghue, 2022 ) . The relation between policy gradients and soft Q-learning provides another view of these coordinates ( Schulman et al., 2017 ) . DPO and its sequential extension relate language-model policies to rewards and action values during post-training ( Rafailov et al., 2023 ; Rafailov et al., 2024 ) .
blocks.zh: 规范化控制和决定几何. 控制为推论和RL为最大py目标通过奖励,动作值和参考分布来表达最佳政策(Levine,2018年;Haarnoja等人,2017年;Haarnoja等人,2018年). 规范化控制供应吉布斯政策和价值差距几何(Geist等人,2019年;O ' Donoghue,2022年). 政策梯度与软Q学习之间的关系为这些坐标提供了另一种观点(Schulman等人,2017年)。 DPO及其相继延伸将语言模式政策与培训后的奖励和行动价值联系起来(Rafailov等人,2023年;Rafailov等人,2024年)。

blocks.en: Our optimal action score combines the optimal semantic action value with the semantic reference prior. These coordinates let us compare the decisions induced by different interfaces and measure a deployed policy’s gap to each optimum. The analysis of fine-tuning objectives by Swamy et al. (2025) likewise uses a common geometric description to distinguish ideal equivalence from differences that emerge in practice. Here the distinction concerns the interface’s optimal decisions and the choices that a particular checkpoint makes through it.

blocks.en: Behavioral identification and reward transfer. Inverse RL recovers rewards from behavior subject to ambiguities ( Ng and Russell, 2000 ; Russell, 1998 ) . Reward shaping using a potential function preserves optimal policies ( Ng et al., 1999 ) . Analyses of identifiability under entropy regularization and of partial identifiability characterize the corresponding reward classes ( Cao et al., 2021 ; Skalse et al., 2023 ) . EPIC compares reward functions while accounting for transformations that preserve policies ( Gleave et al., 2021 ) . Work on the transferability of rewards recovered through regularized inverse RL further studies changes in transition laws ( Schlaginhaufen and Kamgarpour, 2024 ) .
blocks.zh: 行为鉴定和奖励转移. 反RL从含糊不清的行为中恢复奖励(Ng和Russell,2000年;Russell,1998年)。 利用潜在功能进行奖励可以保持最佳政策(Ng等人,1999年)。 对应奖励等级的特征是:在 en正规化下可识别性和部分可识别性的分析(Cao等人,2021年;Skalse等人,2023年)。 EPIC比较奖励功能,同时核算保存政策的转变(Gleave等人,2021年). 通过常规反向RL回收的奖励的可转让性工作进一步研究过渡法的变化(Schlaginhaufen和Kamgarpour,2024年)。

blocks.en: Our equivalence class for a single interface removes statewise constants from the scores. Appendix C distinguishes this behavioral object from the nonunique decomposition into prior, reward, and transition. The transfer analysis then compares the target energy with the actual deployed readout, weighting their discrepancy by deployment occupancy.

blocks.en: Interface and agent design. Interface design and prompt formatting affect agent behavior ( Yang et al., 2024 ; Sclar et al., 2024 ; Zhang et al., 2025a ) . ADAS and AFlow search over agent implementations and workflows ( Hu et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2025b ) . Darwin Gödel Machine and Self-Improving Coding Agent revise scaffolds and assess them through execution ( Zhang et al., 2026 ; Robeyns et al., 2025 ) . Promptbreeder, ToolMaker, and MAS-ZERO respectively explore prompts, tools, and designs involving multiple agents ( Fernando et al., 2023 ; Wölflein et al., 2025 ; Ke et al., 2025 ) . Surveys place these approaches within agent systems with mechanisms for self improvement ( Fang et al., 2025 ; Gao et al., 2026 ) .

blocks.en: These design procedures can change action opportunities, realizations, or both. Our analysis separates each candidate’s optimal return from the evaluated checkpoint’s gap to that optimum. This distinction connects execution feedback to two possible sources of improvement: a more useful decision problem and a policy that better realizes its available decisions.

Joint adaptation takes several forms: SIA selects harness and weight updates, Co-Harness trains from trajectories collected under revised interfaces, and WHALE alternates training with harness search ( Hebbar et al., 2026 ; Chen et al., 2026 ; Kim et al., 2026 ) . blocks.en: These methods can use the ceiling and the mismatch to tell whether a candidate harness offers too little or is not yet used well. Our adaptation threshold specifies the mismatch reduction needed to make a revision with a higher ceiling beneficial. Eq. ( 24 ) isolates how a weight update changes a revision’s relative value. Comparisons across checkpoints and interfaces therefore track both recovery after a revision and changes in interface rankings. blocks.en: We describe the experiments in the order of the main text: the MiniWoB++ setup and post-training study, the readout study, the H0-to-H1 adaptation study, the adaptation across harness swaps, the calibration of finite measurements, the independent prediction study, the coding-agent harness study, and the exact comparison of harness scores with task success.

blocks.en: F.1 MiniWoB++ Setup and Post-Training
blocks.zh: F.1 迷你WOB++ 设置和培训后

blocks.en: The controlled study pairs language-model post-training with a finite control model of each harness. This gives every checkpoint a fixed optimal policy to compare against, while retaining task instructions, parameterized actions, and controller feedback in the model’s input.
blocks.zh: 受控研究将语言模式的后培训与每种牵引装置的有限控制模型结合起来。 这使每个检查站都有一个固定的最佳政策来比较,同时保留任务指示、参数化行动以及模型输入中的控制器反馈。

blocks.en: We compare six harnesses, H0–H5, using H0 as the direct baseline.
blocks.zh: 我们用H0作为直接基线来比较6个吊带,H0-H5。

blocks.en: We use three tasks from MiniWoB++ ( Liu et al., 2018 ) . In click-checkboxes , the agent toggles checkboxes to match the requested labels and submits the selection. In click-checkboxes-soft , the requested words and checkbox labels are matched by synonym meaning. In ascending-numbers , the agent clicks five tiles in numerical order, with the remaining numbers hidden after the first click. We retain the initially visible layout in the public observation, together with spatial tile IDs, the remaining tiles, and the number of completed clicks. Checkbox observations contain the instruction, each label and its checked status. All actor observations also expose the remaining decision budget and the harness’s controller state.
blocks.zh: 我们用MiniWoB++的三项任务 (刘等,2018). 在点击复选框中,代理切换复选框以匹配请求的标签并提交选择。 在点击- checkboxs-soft 中,请求的单词和复选框标签对应同义词含义. 在升序数中,代理按数字顺序点击五块牌,其余数字在第一次点击后隐藏. 我们保留了公众观测中最初可见的布局,连同空间瓦片ID,剩余瓦片,完成点击的次数. 复选框观察包含指令,每个标签及其检查状态. 所有行动者的观察也揭露了剩余的决策预算以及控制器状态。

blocks.en: The reward is one for exact task completion and zero otherwise, including partial completion. All explicit action and tool costs are zero. Each episode allows at most ten actor decisions, with discount γ = 0.95 \gamma=0.95 per decision. We compile the physical transitions, remaining budget, and controller memory into a finite acyclic graph. For every retained task, we verify a successful run in the native browser and separately compare the compiled transitions and termination rules with the page behavior. Training and exhaustive policy evaluation use these compiled graphs.
blocks.zh: 奖励是对确切任务完成的奖励之一,否则为零,包括部分完成。 所有明确的行动和工具成本均为零。 每集最多允许10个演员决定,每集的折扣为γ=0.95\gamma=0.95. 我们把物理转换,剩余预算,控制器内存 汇编成一个有限的循环图。 对于每个保留的任务,我们都会在本地浏览器中验证一次成功的运行,并将编译的转换和终止规则与页面行为进行单独比较. 培训和详尽的政策评价使用这些汇编的图表。

R1 reverses the order of top-level observation fields while preserving their contents and the nested action dictionary. Estimator calibration uses a separate set of 72 tasks, 24 per family, generated in the same way as the splits in Table 5 and disjoint from all of them. This set is fixed before estimator selection and plays no role in the reported test results. We use the H0 checkpoint at post-training update 1,024 and the H1-adapted checkpoints from Appendix F.3 . All weights are frozen for this study. The control objective uses γ = 0.95 \gamma=0.95 , τ = 0.1 \tau=0.1 , and a horizon of ten model decisions.

blocks.en: F.7 Coding-Agent Harness Study
blocks.zh: F.7 编码-代理优势研究

blocks.en: The study uses the native configurations of DeepAgents, Pi coding-agent, DeepSeek Harness, Terminus-2, and mini-SWE-agent. All file and command tools run inside the benchmark task container. The framework owns its loop, tool feedback, delegation where configured, compression, retries, and termination. Terminus-2 retains tmux, completion confirmation, and summarization. Mini-SWE-agent uses its official tool-call profile. Terminal-Bench Lite contains 39 tasks, scored by the official verifier. The agent never sees scoring data or gold patches.
blocks.zh: 该研究采用了DeepAgents,Pi编码代理,DeepSeek Harness,Terminus-2和迷你SWE代理的本土配置. 所有文件和命令工具都在基准任务容器内运行. 框架拥有其循环、工具反馈、配置地点、压缩、重试和终止。 Terminus-2保留 tmux, 完成确认, 并归纳. 迷你SWE代理使用其官方工具调用简介. 终端-Bench Lite包含39项任务,由官方核查员评分. 代理商从未看到评分数据或金块补丁.

blocks.en: Each harness has three independent runs. Accuracy is the mean of the three single-run success rates over all planned tasks, and the reported spread is the sample standard deviation across runs. Timeouts and failures remain in the denominator as unresolved tasks.
blocks.zh: 每条吊带有三个独立的运行。 准确性是所有计划任务的三个单跑成功率的平均值,所报告的差幅是跨跑的样本标准差. 暂停和失败仍然是未完成的任务。

blocks.en: The target is Qwen3.5-9B with thinking enabled, temperature 0.6, an output limit of 32,768 tokens, and a context window of 65,536 tokens. The teacher is GPT-5.6-luna with the same output and context limits and high reasoning effort. Each trajectory is capped at 50 top-level decisions and uses the task’s own time limit.
blocks.zh: 目标是有思维功能的Quen3.5-9B,温度为0.6,输出限制为32,768令牌,上下文窗口为65,536令牌. 该教师是GPT-5.6-luna,输出和上下文限制相同,推理能力高. 每个轨迹在50个顶级决定中封顶,并使用任务本身的时间限制.

blocks.en: At each model call, we record the request context, tool definitions, controller state, and remaining budgets. Summary, subagent, and retry calls count as decisions. To sample a decision, we resend the recorded request and decode each sample with the harness’s parser, without executing tools. Samples measure the next action distribution at the recorded state.
blocks.zh: 在每个模型调用时,我们记录请求的上下文,工具定义,控制器状态,以及剩余的预算. 汇总,副代理, 和重试呼叫计数为决定。 为了对一个决定进行抽样,我们重新发送记录的请求,并用控制器解码每个样本,而不使用执行工具。 样本在记录状态下测量下一个动作分布.

blocks.en: The probes use three Terminal-Bench Lite tasks: acl-permissions-inheritance , analyze-access-logs , and bank-trans-filter . For each harness, the target and the teacher each contribute three trajectories per task, taken from separate runs of their own. A trajectory enters an estimate only when every recorded state in it has a complete probe. The teacher estimates use 7 of 9 trajectories for Pi coding-agent and all 9 for the other harnesses. The target estimates use 7, 6, and 8 of 9 trajectories for Pi coding-agent, DeepAgents, and DeepSeek Harness, and all 9 for Terminus-2 and mini-SWE-agent.
blocks.zh: 探测器使用三个终端-Bench Lite任务:cl-permissions-inheritance,分析-access-logs,以及bank-trans-filter. 每条绳索,目标与老师各贡献三条轨迹,从各自独立的跑道上取出. 轨迹只有在记录到的每个状态都有完整的探测器时,才会进入一个估计值. 老师估计Pi编码剂使用9个轨迹中的7个,其他的绳索则全部使用9个轨迹. 目标估计使用Pi编码剂,DeepAgents和DeepSeek Harness的9个轨迹中的7,6和8个,以及Terminus-2和迷你SWE-agent的所有9个轨迹.

blocks.en: Each decoded output maps to one of 13 categories: inspect, modify, verify, setup, run, plan, delegate, wait, stop, context update, return, opaque, and invalid. File reads, listings, and searches map to inspect, and writes, edits, and deletions to modify. Todo and planning operations map to plan, and subagent calls to delegate. Shell commands, including Terminus-2 keystrokes at a shell prompt, are parsed, and a command maps to its dominant operation. Commands whose program the parser cannot resolve map to opaque, and responses without a countable native action map to invalid. The categories merge actions with different arguments and effects, so the estimates compare decisions at the level of these categories.
blocks.zh: 每个解码输出地图为13类之一:检查,修改,验证,设置,运行,计划,委托,等待,停止,上下文更新,返回,不透明,无效. 文件读取、列出和搜索地图以检查、撰写、编辑和删除以修改。 托多和规划行动地图 计划, 和副代理呼叫 委托。 壳牌命令,包括Terminus-2按键在 shell 提示时的键盘被解析,并绘制出其主操作的命令地图. 程序解析器无法解析地图不透明的指令, 以及没有可计数的本地动作地图无效的响应 。 类别合并了具有不同论据和效果的动作,因此估计在这些类别层次上比较决定.
